referents.why: 'who' is masculine plural (hoitines), so it refers to the masculine plural 'rebels' (w8), not to the singular Barabbas.

links.why: 'the one called Barabbas' is a participial description nested in the noun phrase of cl0.
Self-link: a clause cannot be joined by and to itself.
The relative clause 'who had committed murder' is nested in the noun phrase 'the rebels' inside cl0.
